name: Animated Kite
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia World Guide

defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 1)
defensiveAbilities.description: Like normal objects, an animated kite has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated kite is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks and its Armor Class is reduced to 13.

offensiveAbilities.name: Attach Line
offensiveAbilities.description: The animated kite gives its line to an adjacent ally with a free hand. The kite remains attached until the creature releases it or the kite flies more than 60 feet away. A creature between them can also sever the line with a successful Strike against AC 13 that deals any amount of slashing damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sawing Line
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The animated kite has its line attached to an ally

Effect Each creature along the line between the kite and its ally takes 1d6 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save).
